title.de: I went, did you? · Die Vergangenheit
title.it: I went, did you? · Il passato
title.en: I went, did you? · The past simple

description.sl: Kar je minilo (včeraj, lani): preteklik, ne have: Yesterday I went. Vprašanje in nikalnica z did, glagol v osnovni obliki: Did you see? I didn't go. Was in were.
description.de: Was vorbei ist (gestern, letztes Jahr): das Past simple, nicht have: Yesterday I went. Frage und Verneinung mit did, das Verb in der Grundform: Did you see? I didn't go. Was und were.
description.it: Quello che è finito (ieri, l'anno scorso): il past simple, non have: Yesterday I went. Domanda e negazione con did, il verbo alla forma base: Did you see? I didn't go. Was e were.
description.en: What is over (yesterday, last year): the past simple, not have: Yesterday I went. Questions and negatives with did, the verb in its base form: Did you see? I didn't go. Was and were.

review: en, sl, de, it: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

explain.it:

explain.en:

- **Yesterday she went to Ambleside.**

- **Did you see the fox?** · Hast du den Fuchs gesehen?
explain.it:
**Domanda al passato: did + forma base**
- **Did you see the fox?** · Hai visto la volpe?
explain.en:
**A question in the past: did + the base form**
- **Did you see the fox?**

instruction.sl: Which are right? · Katere so pravilne?
instruction.de: Which are right? · Welche sind richtig?
instruction.it: Which are right? · Quali sono giuste?

explain.sl:
**Za did in didn't osnovna oblika; win → won; be brez did**
- **I didn't see her.** · {m:Nisem je videl|f:Nisem je videla}.
- **Were you cold?** · Vas je zeblo?
explain.de:
**Nach did und didn't die Grundform; win → won; be ohne did**
- **I didn't see her.** · Ich habe sie nicht gesehen.
- **Were you cold?** · War dir kalt?
explain.it:
**Dopo did e didn't la forma base; win → won; be senza did**
- **I didn't see her.** · Non l'ho vista.
- **Were you cold?** · Avevi freddo?
explain.en:
**After did and didn't the base form; win → won; be takes no did**
- **I didn't see her.**
- **Were you cold?**
